sources.title: pfnet/plamo-3-translate-0.8b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PLaMo 3 Translate 0.8B is a translation-specialized LLM developed by Preferred Networks (PFN) that delivers world-class translation quality. It is built on PLaMo 3 NICT, a pretrained model developed through joint research by PFN and the National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT).
